ask: Is a grey badge, instead of a question mark, a good way to show a count that may be old?
problem: On the web app, some people could not load the Inbox counts for reports and join requests. The badge then showed nothing, as if no one was waiting.
found: The web page could not renew its sign-in, so the server stopped the count requests. The app hid the failure and kept zero. An expired sign-in is a different case, left to LAN-243. I read code only, not live logs.
changed: No more question mark. A count that cannot refresh keeps its last number but turns grey. With no number, a grey dot shows. The app also tries again after 15 seconds.
why: Grey needs no new words and no new screen. It is honest: a red number means sure, grey means maybe old. The pictures are drawings, not screenshots; I could not run the web app.
touches: Screen readers keep the old label until all 16 languages are translated. The My Work bell changes the same way.
